turns.question: How big was our customer base in Turkey at the end of September 2026?
turns.answer: Customers to date (everyone signed up by the day) with customer country Turkey (TR) stood at 5 customers on 2026-09-30, the end of September 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
